question: A report named “Payments Vision 2025” is released by which institution?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Reserve Bank of India.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** released a report titled** "Payments Vision 2025"** in** January 2019.**
 
• The report outlines the **central bank's vision** for the future of **digital payments** in India and sets out a roadmap for achieving that vision.
 
• The report covers various aspects of the** payments ecosystem,** including **regulatory issues, infrastructure development, and innovation **in payment technologies.
 
• The report also emphasizes the need for** collaboration among stakeholders **to achieve the goals outlined in the vision document.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Finance:**

 
 
• The Ministry of Finance is responsible for the management of** public finances **in India.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog:** 
 
 
• NITI Aayog is a **think tank** that provides **policy recommendations** to the Indian government.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Corporate Affairs:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Corporate Affairs is responsible for **regulating the corporate sector** in India.
